verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows PlanetScale publishes granular per-unit pricing (storage $1.25/mo per 10GB, $15/mo per 100M rows read, $15/mo per 10M rows written) and docs confirm pricing can even be queried via SQL and usage viewed per database, supporting predictable-bill claims for storage and traffic. However, compute/cluster pricing specifics are not evidenced beyond the queryable pricing table, and the concrete numbers come from an older HN post rather than current docs. Missing for 10: current documented compute per-unit rates, first-party confirmation the storage/traffic numbers are still accurate, and independent corroboration of billing predictability in practice.
